items.text: Introducing Gemini Decision 1, our new frontier decision model in the Gemini API. It is $0.10 per 1M input tokens with no additional cost. With support for image, audio, video, and PDF natively, 256K context window, & 1K questions. You can try it for free in the API!

items.title: Locating the source of a mysterious beep with Claude
items.text: Our house has a box room, full of boxes that we still haven't unpacked from our last move. A couple of weeks ago something in that room started intermittently beeping . The beeps were far enough apart that standing in the room and trying to determine the source of the noise was frustrating, and I really didn't want to dig through every one of those boxes. So I had Claude Code build Beep Locator , a software system for triangulating the source of a mysterious beep using multiple devices scattered around the room.

items.title: AWS releases AWS Emulator, a free tool that simulates 200+ services locally, saying AI agents wrote…
items.text: AWS releases AWS Emulator, a free tool that simulates 200+ services locally, saying AI agents wrote it and its team hasn't written or reviewed any of its code. AWS says its engineers didn't write or review a single line of code in its newest developer tool, and the company is touting that as a selling point.
